_comment: **A placed feature and not a bare configured one**, because only a placed feature has a word: see
`DerivedWords.features`, which makes one word per entry of the registry. `torchflowers` is therefore
sayable the moment this file exists -- `in jungle, features torchflowers`, or Age-wide, which reaches
the jungle too. Both phrasings satisfy the scarab (design §7.1.2).
No biome carries it, so nothing grows it until a book asks: this is the one flower whose presence is
**`MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES` where vanilla's flowers use `MOTION_BLOCKING`**, which matters because
these are for a jungle: on the plain heightmap nearly every attempt lands on the canopy, fails
`canSurvive` and places nothing, so the flowers would thin out exactly where they are needed.
A handful per chunk in the chunks that get any, so the flowers arrive in clearings rather than evenly
-- a stand somebody wrote into a jungle, and a standing larder the colony grazes and comes back to.
